issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to provide an initializer init(books: [Book]) (an array of Book). The solution implementation defines the stored property as let books: [Book] but implements init(books: Set<Book>) (a Set). This constructor parameter type does not match the problem specification and also conflicts with the declared property type in the solution, which would confuse students and likely cause compilation errors or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the initializer parameter type consistent with the problem statement and the stored property. Update the solution (and template if applicable) to use init(books: [Book]) so the parameter is an array of Book and can be assigned to let books: [Book]. Alternatively, if a Set is intended, change the stored property to let books: Set<Book> and update the problem statement to require a Set, but prefer changing the initializer to [Book] to match the spec.
